name: Widar3.0
summary: Large cross-domain gesture dataset with raw CSI and body-coordinate velocity profile representations across users, rooms, positions, and orientations.

settings.scenario: Cross-domain gestures across 3 rooms, 15 locations, 5 orientations, and 16 users

standardization.notes: This sample is processed BVP, not raw CSI. Reshape the released SenseFi CSV from [22 time bins, 400 flattened velocity bins] to [22 time bins, 20 x-velocity bins, 20 y-velocity bins]. Preserve the released BVP, add SenseFi's fixed normalized companion, and do not invent a packet rate, subcarrier axis, or Tx/Rx axes.
